analysis_provenance.visual_method: Temporal contact sheets sampled every 6 seconds; close inspection around major discontinuities; FFmpeg scene-score candidate detection at threshold 0.24
analysis_provenance.audio_method: Confirmed audio stream and ran automatic silence detection; no speech transcription or semantic music identification performed
analysis_provenance.scope: First-pass visual editing-pattern and narrative-mechanism analysis, not an exhaustive frame-by-frame edit decision list
analysis_provenance.timestamp_accuracy: Approximate except machine-detected scene candidate boundaries
do_not_infer: exact number of editorial cuts from scene-score threshold

transferable_patterns.trigger: An extended stretch of legible gameplay where the player is exploring or building toward a consequence
transferable_patterns.strategy: Keep gameplay visible long enough for viewer comprehension; interrupt only with purposeful edits
transferable_patterns.avoid: Automatic cuts solely to hit an arbitrary high cut rate

transferable_patterns.trigger: Clearly recognized repeated death/failure/event across a session
transferable_patterns.strategy: Track count with a small consistent overlay; increment on verified event; treat the count as an accumulating running joke
transferable_patterns.avoid: Copying the reference creator's unique graphical assets or counting uncertain events

transferable_patterns.trigger: Well-timed abrupt failure, reset, or comic transition
transferable_patterns.strategy: Insert a brief original faux-broadcast-interruption bumper; recurring visual treatment increases familiarity
transferable_patterns.avoid: Overusing an interruption or reusing the exact branded/third-party screen

transferable_patterns.trigger: Moment suited to an absurd quantitative comparison or impossible calculation
transferable_patterns.strategy: Briefly overlay an original exaggerated math/stat graphic as a punchline
transferable_patterns.avoid: Injecting a graphic unrelated to what actually happened

transferable_patterns.strategy: Switch decisively from gameplay to original branded end-card with follow/subscribe or next-video slots
